title: Normalized gene-level fold changes
prompt: For the genes MLH1, BRCA2, RPL11, MGMT, HX0042, report the gene-level log2 fold change of helixin treatment versus vehicle control. Use only samples that pass QC, account for differences in sequencing depth, compute sgRNA-level log2 fold changes, and summarize each gene by the median of its sgRNAs.
grader_plain: Each gene's LFC within ±0.2 of the reference. Total-count, CPM, median-of-ratios or non-targeting normalization with pseudocount 0.5–1 all land within 0.05; skipping normalization shifts values by ~+1, and keeping the bottlenecked replicate or comparing to day0 moves at least one gene out of tolerance.
traps: comparing against day0 instead of vehicle
context: You are analyzing a pooled CRISPR knockout screen. The workspace contains raw sgRNA read counts (counts.tsv), a sample sheet, gene sets and a short design document (design.md). Read design.md first.
